tonight.headline: The lineup is right — nothing to do until Thursday
body: Bad news first: Waddle still has no practice line since his concussion, Warren faces a Philadelphia defence that allows the 5th-fewest running-back points, and Boston is on bye. Your Steelers D/ST claim landed at 02:59 CDMX, so the Packers' bye is covered.
ESPN projects 137.0 to 100.8. Panda Attack start two byes (DeMario Douglas, Harold Fannin Jr.) with Cam Skattebo on their bench; filled, they are nearer 125. Nothing on your side needs changing.

case.label: The script that beats you
case.body: Panda Attack slide Skattebo (14.5) into the flex, move Tee Higgins to receiver and add a tight end (Okonkwo 10.1 is free): roughly 100.8 + 14.5 + 10 ≈ 125 against your 137.1 (league file).

case.label: What would change it
case.body: Geno Smith ruled out for the Jets (Wilson's quarterback) or Hockenson back for Minnesota — both trim a starter, neither flips the lineup on today's numbers.

roster.footnote: No Week 11 game has kicked off. Matchup tiles use fantasyteamadvice's 2026 schedule-adjusted points allowed by position (fetched 18 Nov), ranked fewest-allowed first; D/ST, kicker and the bye are not graded.
